        <script><![CDATA[var MSSCustodyAmendUtilsPassive = Class.create();
MSSCustodyAmendUtilsPassive.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    evalAmendEligibility: function() {

        /*
		Eligibility Check Artifacts: 
		Script Include : x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyAmendUtils - evalAmendEligibility
		System Property: x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.enableautomatedamend.market - Only available markets will allow this script to execute
		System Property: x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.enableautomatedamend.outcomes - Only available markets will allow this script to execute
		Client Script:	MSS Validate Trade Amendment Inputs
		Client Script:	Show Amend Fields in Bulk Form
		Client Script:	MSS Task Prepopulate Amend from Trade
		Client Script:	MSS Task Create Bulk for Amend

		Usage: 

		var eligbleCheck = new GlideAjax('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyAmendUtils');
    	eligbleCheck.addParam('sysparm_name', 'evalAmendEligibility');
    	eligbleCheck.addParam('sysparm_recOutcome', g_form.getValue('outcome'));
    	eligbleCheck.addParam('sysparm_recSysID', g_form.getUniqueValue());
		eligbleCheck.addParam('sysparm_tableName', 'x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_task'); // modify the table accordingly and include new method to glide record to set owning business
   	 	eligbleCheck.getXMLAnswer(handleEligiblity);

    	function handleEligiblity(check) {
        //g_form.addInfoMessage('Eligible ' + check);
        if (check.toString() == 'true') {

			   }
			}
		*/

        try {

            var tradeOwningBusiness = '';
            var amendMarket = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.enableautomatedamend.market');
            var amendOutcomes = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.enableautomatedamend.outcomes');
            var recOutcome = this.getParameter('sysparm_recOutcome');
            var recSysID = this.getParameter('sysparm_recSysID');
            var tableName = this.getParameter('sysparm_tableName');

            if ((recOutcome == '') || (recOutcome == null) || (recOutcome == undefined)) { // if no outcome provided returning false
                return false;
            }


            //Trade Task Table
            if (tableName.indexOf('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyAmendUtilsPassive') > -1) {
                var getTaskDetails = new GlideRecord(tableName);
                getTaskDetails.get(recSysID);
                tradeOwningBusiness = getTaskDetails.trade_id.owning_business.toString();
            }

            //Bulk Table
            if (tableName.indexOf('x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_o_hsbc_bulk_transaction') > -1) {
                var getBulkDetails = new GlideRecord(tableName);
                getBulkDetails.get(recSysID);
                tradeOwningBusiness = getBulkDetails.owning_business.toString();
            }

            //Set new method if any other table is being used in the sysparm_tableName parameter

            if ((amendMarket.indexOf(tradeOwningBusiness) > -1) && (amendOutcomes.indexOf(recOutcome) > -1)) {
                return true;
            } else {
                return false;
            }


        } catch (ex) {
            gs.info('Error Message from evalAmendEligibility ' + ex);
        }

    },

    hideAmendFieldsBasedonMarket: function() { //MSSCUSTODY-7210

        var market = this.getParameter('sysparm_tradeMarket');
        var getFields = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.amendMarketSpecificFields');
        var marketFields = JSON.parse(getFields)
        marketFields = marketFields[market];
        return marketFields;

    },

    getTradeFieldvalues: function() {

        try {

            //This method is to prepropulate the amend fields for automated task when the outcome is selected as Amend related outcomes
            //Once the form is submitted, the below method executes creating a culk and associating the responses provided by user to bulk record
            var tradeID = this.getParameter('sysparm_tradeID');
            var taskID = this.getParameter('sysparm_taskID');

            var getTask = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_task_passive');
            getTask.get(taskID);

            var taskStatus = getTask.active;

            if (taskStatus) {

                var amendInputs = {};
                var getTradeData = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade_passive');
                getTradeData.get(tradeID);

                var tradefieldValues = ['security_id', 'trade_date', 'settlement_date', 'deal_price', 'deal_price_currency', 'settlement_amount_currency', 'settlement_amount', 'counterparty_reference', 'customer_reference', 'location_code', 'hold_matched_si_indicator', 'script_hold_indicator', 'cash_hold_indicator', 'gdi_indicator', 'cash_payment_method', 'switch_indicator', 'switch_account', 'counterparty_code', 'receiver_deliverer_custodian_bic', 'buyer_seller_bic', 'place_of_settlement_95a_qualifier_pset', 'u_client_s_seller_buyer_account', 'convert_to_account_switching', 'counterparty_cash_account_id', 'suspense_account_number', 'amend_charges_type', 'amend_charges_ccy', 'amend_charges_amt', 'nssc', 'si_purpose_code', 'data_source_scheme', 'propriety_code']; //populate amend values
                var requestHeaders = ['securityID', 'tradeDate', 'settlementDate', 'dealPrice', 'dealCurrency', 'settlementCurrency', 'settlementAmount', 'counterPartyRef', 'cusRef', 'locCode', 'hmiIndicator', 'scripholIndicator', 'cashHoldIndicator', 'gdiIncidcator', 'payMethod', 'switchIndicator', 'switchAcc', 'counterParCode', 'delivererCusBic', 'sellBuyBic', 'placeofSett', 'accOfClient', 'converAccSwitch', 'counterSettAccNum', 'susAccNum', 'amendChargesType', 'amendChargesCCY', 'amendChargesAmt', 'amendNSSC', 'amendPurposeCode', 'amendDataSource', 'amendProprietyCode']; // request body header

                for (i = 0; i < tradefieldValues.length; i++) {

                    if ((getTradeData.getValue(tradefieldValues[i]) != '') && (getTradeData.getValue(tradefieldValues[i]) != null) && (getTradeData.getValue(tradefieldValues[i]) != undefined)) {
                        var nonNullRequestHeadersname = requestHeaders[i];
                        var nonNullTrdValue = getTradeData.getValue(tradefieldValues[i]);
                        amendInputs[nonNullRequestHeadersname] = nonNullTrdValue;

                    } else {
                        var nullRequestHeadersname = requestHeaders[i];
                        amendInputs[nullRequestHeadersname] = '';
                    }
                }

                return JSON.stringify(amendInputs);
            } else {

                return false;
            }

        } catch (error) {
            gs.info("Error from AmendInputs getTradeFieldvalues" + error.message);
        }


    },


    type: 'MSSCustodyAmendUtilsPassive'
});]]></script>
